data.meta_description: Book your Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party from Puerto Banús. Dance, sunbathe & cruise the Costa del Sol on a private boat. Prices from €749. Reserve now.

faq.q: What is included in a Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your party spirit.

faq.q: How much does a yacht party cost for Marbella Pride 2037?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I bring my own music and decorations?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring a Bluetooth speaker or use the onboard sound system. Rainbow flags, balloons, and decorations are welcome, but please check with us in advance for any restrictions.

faq.q: How many people can join a Pride yacht party?

faq.q: Where do Pride yacht parties depart from?
faq.a: All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the iconic marina in Marbella. You can also arrange pickup from Marbella Marina or Cabopino upon request.

faq.q: What is the best time for a Pride yacht party?
faq.a: Afternoon charters (2–6 PM) offer the best sun and sea conditions. Sunset cruises (6–8 PM) are popular for golden-hour photos. The Mediterranean is calmest from June to September.

faq.q: Can I book a yacht for a private Pride event?
faq.a: Absolutely. All our charters are private — you and your guests only. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your preferred date and boat.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on Pride day?
faq.a: We monitor conditions closely. If the captain deems it unsafe, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. Marbella enjoys 320 sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2037 is set to be the biggest celebration of diversity on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to join the party than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from Puerto Banús, our Pride yacht parties combine sun, sea, and music for an unforgettable experience. Whether you're part of the LGBTQ+ community or an ally, a boat charter offers a safe, stylish space to celebrate with friends. Prices start at €749 for two hours on an Astondoa 40, including skipper, drinks, and snacks. Read on for everything you need to know about booking your Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party.

Why choose a yacht party for Marbella Pride 2037?

A yacht party gives you total freedom to celebrate Pride your way. Instead of queuing at crowded beach clubs, you'll cruise the Mediterranean with your own playlist, your own drinks, and your own crew. The views of La Concha mountain and the Marbella coastline are spectacular from the water. With 320 sunny days a year in Marbella, the weather in June 2037 should be perfect — expect sea temperatures around 22–24 °C. You can anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop, or simply dance on deck as you pass by the Golden Mile.

Our fleet for Pride 2037

We offer a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick overview:

Pricing and what's included

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are the most affordable option for Pride parties: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Tier B (Mangusta 80, available in white or grey) costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request — just message us on WhatsApp.

Every charter includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Itinerary ideas for your Pride yacht party

Most Pride charters head west from Puerto Banús towards Estepona or east towards Cabopino. Popular stops include:

  • Cala del Faro — a quiet cove with crystal-clear water, ideal for swimming.
  • Cala Cortés — a picturesque beach only accessible by boat.
  • Río Verde — anchor near the mouth of the river for a scenic lunch spot.
  • Estepona Marina — a 30-minute cruise, perfect for a photo stop.

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences. Sunset cruises (18:00–20:00) are especially popular during Pride week.

How to book your Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat choice. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. A deposit secures your slot — full payment is due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking early, as Pride charters fill up fast. For more information, check our Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party guide.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in a Marbella Pride 2037 yacht party?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your party spirit.

How much does a yacht party cost for Marbella Pride 2037?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Can I bring my own music and decorations?

Yes, you can bring a Bluetooth speaker or use the onboard sound system. Rainbow flags, balloons, and decorations are welcome, but please check with us in advance for any restrictions.

How many people can join a Pride yacht party?

Capacity varies by boat: Astondoa 40 holds 9 passengers, Azimut 39 holds 11, Mangusta 80 holds 12, and smaller boats like Dubhe hold 5. Larger yachts (Ferretti 94, Canados 86) also accommodate up to 12.

Where do Pride yacht parties depart from?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the iconic marina in Marbella. You can also arrange pickup from Marbella Marina or Cabopino upon request.

What is the best time for a Pride yacht party?

Afternoon charters (2–6 PM) offer the best sun and sea conditions. Sunset cruises (6–8 PM) are popular for golden-hour photos. The Mediterranean is calmest from June to September.

Can I book a yacht for a private Pride event?

Absolutely. All our charters are private — you and your guests only. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your preferred date and boat.

What happens if the weather is bad on Pride day?

We monitor conditions closely. If the captain deems it unsafe, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. Marbella enjoys 320 sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.
